run_video_annotator_cli: run the video annotator CLI to generate tasks for annotating videos with config validation
run_config_verify: run the config subcommand to verify all JSON configs in the video annotator data directory
run_config_update_file_urls: run the config subcommand to update separate-token values config with file URLs from an S3 folder
run_config_extrapolate_token_sets: run the config subcommand to generate assignment versions based on extrapolated values of token sets
run_config_permutate_separate_tokens: run the config subcommand to create token sets as all permutations of separate-token values lists
